messages:
ivy: Customer on mobile reported duplicated and out-of-order fragments after a resume. This one looked differenttwo reconnects overlapped and proxy failover probably replayed fragments twice.
ivy: Repro (flaky): start stream -> trigger auth refresh AND network roam so client reconnects twice within ~120ms -> resume token present -> final output contains duplicated parts and jumbled order.
ivy: Wire excerpt:
```
evt id=900 part=1 data:\"Hel\"
connection: reset (client -> proxy A)
reconnect resume=rt_z42 (to proxy B)
evt id=900 part=2 data:\"lo\"
evt id=901 part=1 data:\" wor\"
(replay from proxy A) evt id=900 part=2 data:\"lo\"
```
ivy: Looks like proxy A and proxy B both sent part=2 (duplicate) and ordering mixed.
quentin: If failover causes both proxies to replay the same resume window, clients can see duplicates. We didn't account for cross-proxy dedupe.
marie: Short-term client mitigation: dedupe on (seq,part,origin) where origin could be resume_token+connection_id. But many clients don't surface connection_id. Recommend SDKs add optional de-dup buffer when resume detected.
quentin: Runtime fix: introduce a resume-lease id stamped into replayed fragments (X-Resume-Source) and ensure only the winner replays. Also add X-Chunk-Seq+X-Chunk-Part. That way client can dedupe and order deterministically.
proxy-bot: Created ticket PROXY-3054: dedupe on resume across HA failover and emit X-Resume-Source header.
marie: I'll open a tiny mobile-sdk PR that adds opt-in dedupe-on-resume using (seq,part,source) and a short retention window (200ms). Keep opt-in because it has memory tradeoffs for high-throughput apps.
ci-bot: deploy: mobile-sample/0.2.5-canary -> canary at 2026-04-10T10:21:00Z by marie :rocket:
quentin: Also adding an integration test in proxy that simulates dual-replay on leader change. Prevent regressions.
ivy: Thanks. Once canary verifies we'll schedule runtime change behind a feature flag and update docs/docs/streaming-reconnects.md with HA failover guidance.
